# Grand Transition Copilot instructions

Read and follow [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md). Then read the applicable approved
specification and select a matching workflow from
[`skills/SKILLS.md`](skills/SKILLS.md).

Do not treat files in `tmp/`, AI prompts, or generated evidence as product
authority. Do not claim a repository command passes until it exists and runs.

Use the Microsoft Learn Model Context Protocol (MCP) server when official
Microsoft or Azure information that is valid on the review date
documentation or code samples materially help the task. Search first and fetch
the relevant page when complete context is needed. Continue without it for
unrelated work.
